INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — MOCK EXAM #20
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for comprehension.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for comprehension.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for comprehension.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for comprehension.

   D. Copy random text without understanding Reading 3.2.1 Extensive reading: Vocabulary building.

   A. Mix random languages with no purpose
   B. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
